persons.name: Jayajitāmitramalladeva
persons.evidence: śrīśrīsumatijayajitāmitra malladevasana, navarātra daśamīcālana, saṃphuli dayakā julāṃ

date.as_written: samvat 814 phālguna śukla pūrṇṇimā, pūrvvāṣāḍha bṛhaspativāra

notes: The scribe refers to himself anonymously in the scribal stanza ('likhitaṃ mayā'). The catalogue identifies the place as Bhaktapur based on the reigning monarch Jitāmitra Malla, though no place name is explicitly stated in the colophon text.
